question: Should hybrid search retain every keyword-backed result below `minScore` whenever strict results exist, or should lexical relaxation remain limited to the no-strict-results fallback while the related CJK and multimodal PRs are consolidated?
rationale: Both choices are technically plausible but produce different recall and precision behavior for existing memory-search users; the repository needs a single intentional retrieval policy rather than overlapping independent fixes.

options.title: Consolidate a single retrieval policy
options.body: Compare this branch with the active CJK and multimodal hybrid PRs, then land one rebased implementation with explicit behavior tests for the selected policy.

options.title: Keep lexical relaxation fallback-only
options.body: Preserve the existing rule that below-threshold keyword hits are returned only when no strict hybrid result exists, and close or narrow this branch accordingly.

options.title: Accept broad keyword preservation
options.body: Adopt this branch's broader recall behavior and document that keyword-backed results may appear below the configured score threshold.

recommendation.title: Consolidate a single retrieval policy
recommendation.body: Compare this branch with the active CJK and multimodal hybrid PRs, then land one rebased implementation with explicit behavior tests for the selected policy.
